name: capture_the_flag
title: Capture the Flag
description: Two players on a grid. Each has a unit and a flag at their base. Grab the enemy flag and return it home to win. If you enter your own territory and step onto the enemy unit, they are tagged and respawn at their base (dropping the flag if they were carrying it).

episodeSteps.description: Maximum number of turns before the game ends in a draw.

rows.description: Board height. P1 territory is the top rows, P2 territory is the bottom rows. Odd values leave a neutral middle row.

p1_flag_pos.description: Position of Player 1's flag as [row, col]. Equals p1_base when not carried; equals p2_pos when carried by Player 2.

p2_flag_pos.description: Position of Player 2's flag as [row, col]. Equals p2_base when not carried; equals p1_pos when carried by Player 1.

p1_base.description: Player 1's home base [row, col]. Fixed for the whole game.

p2_base.description: Player 2's home base [row, col]. Fixed for the whole game.

p1_has_flag.description: True if Player 1 is carrying Player 2's flag.

p2_has_flag.description: True if Player 2 is carrying Player 1's flag.

mark.description: Which player this agent is: 1 or 2.

action.description: Move direction: STAY, NORTH (row-1), SOUTH (row+1), EAST (col+1), WEST (col-1). Moves off the board or onto an opponent square in non-tag territory are treated as STAY.
